disposition.reason: This docket appeals a Waitsfield DRB decision upholding a notice of violation for an unpermitted storage container placed within the front setback; it is a municipal appeal, but a notice-of-violation appeal about a storage container, not permission for new housing.

evidence.quote: This is an appeal of a Town of Waitsfield Development Review Board (DRB) decision denying Edward and Courtney Spaulding’s (Appellants) appeal of a February 13, 2023 Notice of Violation
regarding the placement of a storage container on their property at 31 Center Fayston Road, Waitsfield,
which involves an allegedly unpermitted structure in a front yard setback pursuant to local zoning.

judgments.note: All four decisions describe the docket as an appeal of a DRB decision upholding a notice of violation for a storage container in the front setback; the guide treats NOV appeals and accessory storage as not new housing, so excluded.
Appeal of a DRB decision on a zoning administrator's NOV under 24 V.S.A. Chapter 117.
Subject is a storage container at an existing home; no housing is proposed.

history.note: Excluded: NOV appeal over a storage container in the front setback, not new housing.
